rationale: Y explicitly hits gcanlin's core architecture complaint (cudagraph_mode shouldn't be read in the model layer) and proposes removing it now rather than deferring, precisely sharpens the PR's own TODO about seed-drop under full cudagraphs, and uniquely flags that talker_mtp_graph_safe=True is unsafe on NPU — which lines up with the real post-merge NPU capture crash Wallbreazzz reported. X is thorough and correctly covers the seed-fallback bug and the benchmark-isolation concern, but misses the architecture concern entirely and leans on several unverifiable 'PR body claims' quotes not evidenced in the visible diff, slightly weakening grounding. Both provide concrete file/line fixes and are comparably actionable, but Y's code-level patches are tied more tightly to verifiable diff content.
